SELECT "customer_months"."month" "month", "customer_months"."sum_customer_mon" "qualifying_order" 
FROM (
  SELECT "customer_months"."month" "month", SUM("customer_months"."customer_month_o") "sum_customer_mon" 
  FROM (
    SELECT "orders".customer_id "customer_id", DATE_TRUNC('month', timezone('UTC', "orders".ordered_at::timestamptz)) "month", COUNT(DISTINCT "orders".order_id) "customer_month_o" 
    FROM  comparison_orders  AS "orders"
    GROUP BY 1, 2
    HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT "orders".order_id) > ?)
  ) AS "customer_months"
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY "customer_months"."month" ASC NULLS LAST
) AS "customer_months"
LIMIT 50000
